text: Absolutely loving it so far! Compared to other similar apps, Levla is much more customisable and has enough gamification to it to scratch the dopamine centers of your brain, without being so gamey it becomes a distraction. Very customisable with various options for "to dos" you can check off and "habits" which you can set to repeat at any interval of your choosing. you can create "habits" in different ways; tick boxes, timers, counters, etc. Great UI and communicative mod / dev, highly recommend

text: Sorry, this game is a rpg but it's not really made for RPG players sorry, you have to understand that rpg players aren't looking to do something irl to get some stuff done in their mobile game, I feel like this game doesn't understand it's public audience well, rpg players aren't looking to manage their weaknesses irl, even more in mobile game. I could barely understand how you recover stamina, and that is something that ALWAYS regenerates when you go offline from other mobile games, you know.

developer_reply: Hi there, thank you for trying out Levla. It was never intended to be a game, and we believe that's awesome! All the best <3 / Mod ed

text: Honestly a genius app. Runescape-like world where the tasks are things you need to do in real life. Knocking out chores and bills is now a game. You create the tasks yourself. Think of things you don't really want to do and those can be tasks, but its not ALL about chores. Its about self-help. Some tasks can be relaxing.
